definition: I. [ נָדַד ] verb retreat, flee, depart, stray, wander, flutter (Late Hebrew id. ; Arabic flee, run away ; Aramaic hate, abominate, shrink from , Aph`el put to flight , etc.; נְדַד flee ); — Qal Perfect 3 feminine singular נָָֽדְדָה Isa 10:31 ; Esth 6:1 3 plural נָָֽדְדוּ Hos 7:13 + 4 t., נָדָ֑דוּ Isa 21:15 ; Jer 4:25 Imperfect יִדּוֺד Nah 3:7 3 feminine singular וַתִּדֹּד Gen 31:40 3 masculine plural יִדֹּדוּן Ps 68:13 (twice in verse); Infinitive construct נְדֹד Ps 55:8 Participle נֹדֵד Jer 49:5 +; feminine נוֺדֶ֫דֶת Prov 27:8 plural נֹדְדִים Hos 9:17 — 1. retreat, flee Isa 21:15 from before ( מִפְּנֵי ) swords ; Isa 33:3 at the sound ( מִקּוֺל ) of tumult ; absolute Isa 10:31 ; Isa 22:3 ; Ps 68:13 (twice in verse), of birds and beasts Jer 4:25 ; Jer 9:9 (+ הָלָ֑כוּ ); participle= fugitive Isa 16:3 ; Isa 21:14 of fleeing in horror, disgust, with מִן person Nah 3:7 ; Ps 31:12 . 2. flee, depart , Israel from (מִןׅ ׳ י Hos 7:13 of sleep ( מֵעֵינַי ) Gen 31:40 ( E ), absolute Esth 6:1 . 3. wander, stray (homeless, compare נוד ), עוֺף נוֺדֵד Isa 16:2 (in simile), so Prov 27:8 ( מִן local, in simile), compare v Prov 27:8 ( מִן local); of scattered Israel Hos 9:17 ; Jer 49:5 (searching) for food Job 15:23 (wicked man); אַרְתִיק נְדֹד Ps 55:8 I will wander afar. 4. transitive flutter wings (of bird, in figure) Isa 10:14 . Po`el Perfect consecutive שֶׁמֶשׁ זָָֽרְחָה וְנֹדַ֔ד Nah 3:17 the sun hath arisen and it ( the locust swarm) fleeth away. Hiph`il chase away, Imperfect 3 masculine plural suffix וּמִתֵּבֵל יְנִדֻּ֑הוּ Job 18:18 (of wicked, || יֶהְדְּפֻהוּ מֵאוֺר ). Hoph`al be chased away, Imperfect 3 masculine singular וְיֻדַּד כְּחֶזְיוֺן Job 20:8 (of wicked); קוֺץ מֻנָֿד 2Sam 23:6 thorns thrust away (si vera lectio, compare Dr .; Klo Bu HPS מִדְבָּר ׳ ק ). Hithpo`el. Imperfect יִתְנוֺדְדוּ Ps 64:9 flee away (in horror, disgust, compare Qal Nah 3:7 ; Ps 31:12 ).
